name: IAR 823
summary: Romanian low-wing trainer with a Lycoming IO-540, retractable gear and room for five; used by the Romanian Air Force and aeroclubs and now owned by US sport and warbird pilots.

wings: Low, cantilever, tapered wing with rounded tips
Plain wing with no wingtip tanks
engines: Single flat-six with a constant-speed propeller
fuselage: Large framed bubble canopy over side-by-side seats and a rear bench
tail: Horizontal tail mounted on the rear fuselage

tellTales: Large bubble canopy over side-by-side seats on a low-wing, retractable-gear airplane
Rounded, Piper-like proportions with a glazed canopy
No tip tanks or tandem seating, unlike most military trainers

confusedWith.howToTell: The SF.260 has tandem-style seating, tip tanks and a pencil-slim fuselage; the IAR-823 has a deeper fuselage and a framed canopy.
The S.205 is a civilian four-seat with a cabin roof and a different canopy; the IAR-823 has a bubble canopy and a military look.
The Bulldog has fixed gear and a tall swept fin; the IAR-823 has retractable gear.
The DA40 is a composite with a T-tail and a different canopy; the IAR-823 is a metal low-wing with retractable gear.
